notice_ar: مُهِمَّةُ فَحْصٍ مِنْ إِعْدادِ بَصيرَة، غَيْرُ مُقَنَّنَةٍ
notice_en: Basira-authored screening task, not standardized. Raw score only; no norms apply.
format_source: Block structure after Butterworth, B. (2003) Dyscalculia Screener (reaction time, dot enumeration, number comparison, arithmetic); items newly generated by Basira.

blocks.instructions_en: Tap as soon as the star appears. Show it after a random 1-3 s pause. Baseline only, not scored.
How many dots? Answer on the 1-9 keypad.
